newsitem.title: GERMANY: Luxembourg says U.S. wrong to limit NATO expansion.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg says U.S. wrong to limit NATO expansion.

text.p: Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker criticised the United States on Thursday for saying it would back only three countries for quick admission to NATO, saying Romania and Slovenia should also be considered.
"I am sure Romania and Slovania will also have a place in NATO," he told a business conference in Bonn organised by German Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU).

"The United States should get to know the interior policies of these countries before making such statements," said Juncker, whose country takes over the European Union presidency from the Netherlands next month.

The United States said earlier it wanted to invite only Poland, the Czech Republic, and Hungary to join the alliance at a July 8-9 summit in Madrid, when all NATO members must approve any expanision agreed by Western leaders.

U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen told NATO defence ministers meeting in Brussels of Washington's decision to limit enlargement to the three former communist enemies and not include Slovenia and Romania.
Both Slovenia and Romania pledged to pursue their campaigns to be included among the first wave of new NATO members.
